# MicroC0re repository instructions

Read `/AGENTS.md` and `docs/HANDOFF.md` before making changes.

The GitHub Project `MicroC0re` (#2) Status field is the canonical workflow state. Do not encode Todo/In Progress/Review/Backlog in Issue titles.

Use GitHub-native tools for Issues, PRs, labels and Project cards. Do not ask the maintainer to run PowerShell just for GitHub bookkeeping.

If Project V2 field mutation is unavailable, use exactly one `status:*` workflow label as documented in `docs/HANDOFF.md`; the repository automation maps it to the Project Status field.

Current development is tracked by Epic #14 and draft PR #19. Always verify the live Project/Issues before choosing the next task.
